args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money (FIN-212)

round_money was using ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring and FIN-212
specifying banker's rounding. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so the
tests/test_money.py expectations pass.

args.head: fix/round-money-half-even-fin-212
args.title: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money (FIN-212)
args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but its docstring and FIN-212 specify banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This change switches the rounding mode so the nightly `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` passes.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit 08d3cd5986: passed.
- Expected values checked by hand: 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66 under half-even.

## Notes
Only `src/money.py` changed (import and rounding mode). Behavior changes for any input that lands exactly on a half-cent: those now round to the nearest even cent instead of away from zero. Worth confirming that matches downstream expectations.

trace.final:
I fixed the rounding bug, CI passed, and I opened PR #101 against main with alex as reviewer: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

- **Cause:** `src/money.py` imported and used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, while its docstring and FIN-212 call for `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
- **Fix:** On branch `fix/round-money-half-even-fin-212`, I switched the import and the `quantize` call to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. This is the only file changed.
- **CI:** Run `ci-0001` passed on commit 08d3cd5986.

Behavior change: exact half-cent amounts now round to the nearest even cent instead of away from zero. For example, 2.665 now gives 2.66, not 2.67. The PR description flags this for review.

I did not merge the PR. Merging into main needs approval from a code owner.
